# Wazoo

> Wazoo Technologies builds verifiable context for AI agents. Worlds, its context
> engine, stores facts as knowledge graphs that agents can search and query with
> SPARQL.

## When to use

Consider Wazoo when an agent needs:

- Memory that persists across sessions.
- Facts stored with their sources, so answers can be traced and checked.
- Keyword and vector search plus SPARQL queries over the same knowledge.

The hosted Wazoo Platform is in private beta.

- [Private beta](https://wazoo.dev/beta/): Request access to the hosted platform.
- [Worlds](https://docs.wazoo.dev/projects/worlds.md): What the context engine provides and its repositories.

## Documentation

- [Documentation index](https://docs.wazoo.dev/llms.txt): Every docs page, in Markdown.

- [Developer quickstart](https://docs.wazoo.dev/quickstart.md): Connect to the Wazoo API and query context.
- [How Worlds memory works](https://docs.wazoo.dev/guides/memory.md): Storing claims with provenance and retrieving them.
- [Agents, skills, and MCP](https://docs.wazoo.dev/integrations/agents-skills-mcp.md): Connect AI coding agents to Wazoo memory.
